blocks.x: In his book of al-Da’awat, al-Qutb al-Rawandi reports Imam alRida(a.s.) to have quoted the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) as saying: He who wishes that his status in the Highest Group excels the status of the warriors for Allah’s sake, must repeat the following words of glorification every day. If he has a request to be granted, it will be granted; if he has an enemy to overcome, his enemy will be suppressed; if he has a debt to be settled, his debt will be settled; if he passes by an agony, he will be relieved; and his words will penetrate the Seven Skies to be written down in the Reserved Tablet (al-lawh almahfuz):

سُبْحان اللّٰهِ كَما يَنْبَغى لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُلِلَّهِ كَما يَنْبَغى لِلَّهِ وَ لا اِلهَ اِلا اللّٰهُ كَما يَنْبَغى لِلَّهِ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ كَما يَنْبَغى لِلَّهِ وَ لا حَوْلَ وَ لا قُوَّةَ اِلّا بِالِلَّهِ وَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِىِّ وَ عَلى اَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ جَميعِ الْمُرْسَلينَ وَالنَّبِيّينَ حَتّى يَرْضَى اللّٰهُ
